name: Yongshi Timepieces
description: Precision engineered timepieces, crafted for those who conquer.
story: Yongshi Timepieces, a brand synonymous with relentless pursuit of perfection, seeks to align with motorsport's dedication to speed and precision. Founded in Shanghai, Yongshi has a history of supporting endeavors that push boundaries, and sees motorsport as the ultimate proving ground. They aim to capture the spirit of racing through collaborative limited edition timepieces and elevate their brand image globally.
